item.title: Wine, Proton, and Gaming on Linux

item.title: Wine, Proton, and Gaming on Linux
item.description: Gamescope is the better route to FSR upscaling than WINE_FULLSCREEN_FSR=1, which requires true fullscreen. Gamescope wraps any game — windowed included — in its own micro-compositor, and also gives a frame limiter and independent resolution control.

item.title: MCP Server Development
item.description: In an stdio-transport MCP server, never use console.log — it corrupts the JSON-RPC stream. Write debug output to stderr or a file instead, and return tool errors as isError content blocks rather than throwing, so the AI can see the error and recover.

item.title: MCP Server Development
item.description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and services. A server exposes tools (functions the agent calls), resources (data it reads), and prompts (reusable templates) over JSON-RPC.
